question: In a certain code language, 'DOSIER' is written as 'DEIORS' and 'LOGIC' is written as 'CGILO'. How will 'CORTEX' be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 'DOSIER' is written as 'DEIORS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15443c29618185f7701a247f5a265526bf49dc8d8078de19a8a689b1ea69fba2.png] 

And,

'LOGIC' is written as 'CGILO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c886cac42cb2d650d7a1ba994e338199ca7b3cead0127d494c2c7a30ea0a0d36.png] 

Similarly,

**'CORTEX'** = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17f32ce4a7224b42b3fabdbfb414490302e66e30d4d4ab78eccd2b263e39a50d.png] 

Hence, 'COKE' is coded as "**CEORTX**".
